title: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Iran
publisher: University of Minnesota Human Rights Library
claim: Article 110 gives the Leadership supreme command of the armed forces, war-and-peace powers, and appointment/dismissal authority over key state posts; Article 113 says the president is highest official only outside matters directly concerned with the Leadership.
source_confidence_reason: Primary constitutional text with stable formal allocations of authority and limits.
period_fit: Stable background applicable to 2022.
ruler_attribution: Directly defines the office held by Ali Khamenei in 2022.
contrary_evidence: The text shows formal powers, not whether Khamenei exercised them prudently in 2022.
The president retains ordinary executive responsibility outside Leadership matters.

title: Iran not seeking nuclear weapons, needs atomic energy, says Khamenei
claim: Khamenei said Iran was not seeking nuclear weapons and would further develop peaceful nuclear capacity for independence.
locator: Reuters lead paragraph and quoted speech summary
source_confidence_reason: Reuters wire is strong, but this copy is syndicated through Yahoo rather than Reuters directly.
period_fit: Directly in 2022 and before later escalation steps.
ruler_attribution: Direct Khamenei statement.
contrary_evidence: Reuters also notes Western fears over Iran's nuclear advances and the stalled talks to revive the 2015 deal.
A denial of intent does not itself show restraint in practice.

title: Joint Statement by Mohammad Eslami and Rafael Grossi
claim: Iran's Atomic Energy Organization and the IAEA agreed to accelerate cooperation and exchange written explanations on questions about three sites by 20 March 2022.
source_confidence_reason: Primary IAEA record of a dated cooperation arrangement.
period_fit: Early 2022, directly within the target year.
ruler_attribution: Institutional conduct under Khamenei's system; not a personal statement by Khamenei.
contrary_evidence: Later IAEA statements show the cooperation did not resolve the outstanding issues.
This is procedural cooperation, not proof of a safer end state.

title: Iran won't back down on its 'red lines' in nuclear talks, Raisi says
claim: Raisi said nuclear negotiations were being pursued in full accordance with the framework set by the Supreme Leader, who has the final say in Tehran.
source_confidence_reason: Reuters wire reproduced by Euronews with direct quotation and clear attribution.
period_fit: Directly in 2022, during nuclear talks.
ruler_attribution: Strong attribution to Khamenei's authority over the nuclear file.
contrary_evidence: This concerns negotiating framework, not a documented Khamenei de-escalation choice.
It does not show the content of his private instructions.

title: Leader: Iran's economy should not be tied to US sanctions, country must become impervious to bans
claim: Khamenei told officials not to make economic development conditional on sanctions relief and said the country should be run so sanctions do not hurt it.
source_confidence_reason: State-affiliated outlet quoting Khamenei's televised New Year speech and linking it to khamenei.ir.
period_fit: Directly within 2022 and close to the nuclear negotiations period.
ruler_attribution: Direct Khamenei speech.
contrary_evidence: This is economic strategy rather than nuclear safety policy.
Sanctions resilience can be read as hardline posture rather than risk reduction.

title: Explainer-How close is Iran to being able to build a nuclear bomb?
claim: Reuters explained that Iran's breaches of the JCPOA curbs had reduced breakout time to roughly three to six weeks, with weaponization still taking longer.
source_confidence_reason: Reuters explanatory reporting with quantitative nuclear context and explicit technical framing.
period_fit: Early 2022 baseline for inherited risk posture.
ruler_attribution: Context under Khamenei's rule; not a discrete personal act in the article.
contrary_evidence: The article distinguishes breakout time from weaponization and does not claim a decision to build a bomb.
It is contextual, not proof of intent.

title: Khamenei adviser says Tehran 'capable of building nuclear bomb'
claim: A senior adviser to Khamenei said Iran was technically capable of making a nuclear bomb but had not decided whether to build one.
source_confidence_reason: Reuters wire with direct quotation from a Khamenei adviser, but still one level removed from Khamenei himself.
period_fit: Mid-2022, directly within the period.
ruler_attribution: Indirect attribution through a senior adviser close to Khamenei.
contrary_evidence: The adviser is not Khamenei himself.
The statement denies a decision to build a bomb.

title: IAEA Director General's Introductory Statement to the Board of Governors
claim: Grossi said Iran had not engaged with the IAEA, the safeguards issues remained outstanding, and the Agency could not assure that Iran's nuclear programme was exclusively peaceful.
source_confidence_reason: Primary IAEA statement to the Board with explicit safeguards assessment.
period_fit: Directly in the target year, after the March cooperation attempt.
ruler_attribution: Institutional assessment of Iran under Khamenei's rule.
contrary_evidence: This is an agency assessment, not a finding of weaponization.
It reflects noncooperation more than observed weapon assembly.

title: Iran sets up meeting on IAEA inquiry as diplomatic clash looms
claim: Iran agreed to a visit by the IAEA to start answering questions about uranium particles at three sites, but had not provided new material yet.
source_confidence_reason: Reuters wire with direct quotation and date-specific reporting from the IAEA reporting cycle.
period_fit: Late 2022, directly before the Board resolution and Fordow escalation.
ruler_attribution: Institutional conduct under Khamenei's system.

title: IAEA board passes resolution ordering Iran to cooperate with probe
claim: The IAEA Board of Governors passed a resolution ordering Iran to cooperate urgently with the uranium-trace investigation at three undeclared sites.
source_confidence_reason: Reuters wire reporting a formal IAEA Board action.
period_fit: Directly in late 2022.
ruler_attribution: Institutional response to Iran under Khamenei's rule.
contrary_evidence: A Board resolution shows persistent noncompliance, not a successful restraint outcome.

title: Iran starts enriching uranium to 60% purity at Fordow site - official
claim: Iran began enriching uranium to 60% at Fordow and said it was reacting to political pressure and the IAEA Board resolution.

period_fit: Directly at the end of the target year.
ruler_attribution: AEOI action under Khamenei's supreme authority; the article ties the move to the state response.
contrary_evidence: 60% is below weapons grade, so the step is not by itself weaponization.

contrary_evidence: He also explicitly said the war should be stopped.
